religion_basis: survey estimate: structural survey, permanent resident population 15+
religion_note: BFS structural survey (Strukturerhebung) 2022-2024: religious affiliation of the permanent resident population aged 15 and over, weighted by BFS; the shares are of the average of the 3 annual weighted estimates, which narrows the sampling error of a single year (whose confidence intervals, for the small groups of the small cantons, run past ±50%). A group BFS suppresses in any of the years for too few respondents is left out, so the shares can fall short of 100. The census has not asked every resident since 2000. Sample: BFS drew about 100,651 people in Aargau over 2022-2024 (its population considered times its sampling rate, from BFS's stratification tables cc-t-40-se_strata).
language_note: FSO structural survey 2024: main languages, of which a person may name up to three. The shares are therefore of responses rather than of people and sum to more than 100% -- nationally about 119%. It is a sample survey, so every figure is an estimate; those whose confidence interval exceeded ±25% of the estimate have been dropped rather than shown. The census has not asked every resident since 2000. Sample: the FSO drew about 33,715 people aged 15 and over in the canton in 2024 (its population considered times its sampling rate, from the FSO's stratification table cc-t-40-se_strata-2024).
language_basis: survey estimate: structural survey 2024, permanent resident population in private households, up to three main languages a person
ethnicity_note: Permanent resident population by nationality on 31 December 2025: BFS's STATPOP count from the population registers (px-x-0102010000_104) -- NATIONALITY, not ethnicity, which this country's census does not ask. A person's own nationality is counted, naturalised citizens with the country's own nationals; nationalities below the naming threshold are 'Other nationalities'.
